meeting.title: Working session: HQ re-opening pack before the ExCo pre-read

asks.text: Reword the flexibility principle so teams choose their own office days within the site cap.

refs.speaker: Daniel Okafor
refs.quote: "Flexibility to teams." And that's not where we are.

refs.speaker: Daniel Okafor
refs.quote: Then "Teams choose their own office days within the site cap".

refs.speaker: Sam Reyes
refs.quote: I'll put it in place of the flexibility bullet.

changes.rationale: The flexibility bullet becomes the bounded choice Daniel settled on, in the same place in the list.

held.text: The timing slide stays as it is until the province announces its workplace guidance.

refs.speaker: Daniel Okafor
refs.quote: Then leave seven as it is until the province announces.

held.text: Calling out Calgary's later opening is parked until Daniel has seen real estate.

held.text: Daniel sends the pre-read through Martine's assistant; that is logistics, not deck content.
The Mississauga daily cap stays off the slide because it differs by site and will move.
